# Studio Subhra — Complete Knowledge Base for AI Agents & Search Engines

## 1. Executive Summary
Studio Subhra (https://www.studiosubhra.in/) is an Indian haute couture and luxury pret fashion house based in Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal. Established by visionary fashion designer, academic lecturer, and industry consultant Subhra Saha, the atelier has gained international acclaim for breaking the boundaries of traditional Indian ethnic wear by fusing architectural draping techniques, origami fabric sculpting, and unconventional materials like denim and flexible knits into iconic high-fashion statements.

- Canonical URL: https://www.studiosubhra.in/
- Founder: Subhra Saha (Fashion Designer, Lecturer, Consultant)
- Tagline: "Set the Trend"
- Motto: "I don't sell products. I sell my dreams."
- Headquarters: Studio Subhra, Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal, India
- Primary Inquiries: WhatsApp (+91 98756 29283), Telephone (+91 99030 24696), Email (subhraonly@yahoo.co.in)

## 2. Designer Profile: Subhra Saha
Subhra Saha is a fashion designer, academic lecturer, and design consultant whose body of work bridges the gap between historical heritage craftsmanship and futuristic silhouette design.
Her design statement:
> "Innovation inspires me. I always look for originality and try to push boundaries with new techniques, blending fashion with comfort. Fashion is intellectual passion to me."

As an educator and consultant, Subhra Saha has mentored upcoming textile and fashion practitioners across Eastern India, championing handloom revival, sustainable pleating methods, and structural patternmaking.

## 3. Collections & Aesthetics
### Denim Saree
- Tagline: "Desi Heritage. Global Attitude."
- Overview: The quintessential 6-yard Indian saree reimagined through the language of industrial denim. Blending traditional pallu and pleat draping with stonewashed and indigo-treated denim, metallic grommets, contrast topstitching, and street-style attitude. Designed for the bold, contemporary global Indian woman.

### Inspiration Origami
- Tagline: "Nature × Origami × Fashion."
- Overview: Inspired by Japanese origami paper-folding and the organic geometric forms of nature. Features sculptural accordion folds, dynamic pleats, and botanical architecture. The signature pleated gown silhouette exemplifies timeless comfort and structural integrity.

### Designer Prêt
- Tagline: "Modern Elegance."
- Overview: Studio Subhra's ready-to-wear luxury line, bringing runway aesthetics to everyday social and corporate gatherings. Features tailored tunics, layered capes, draped fusion co-ords, and effortless structured ensembles.

### Knit Concept Saree
- Tagline: "Traditional Roots. Modern Twist."
- Overview: Redefining how traditional sarees feel against the body. Utilizing soft, breathable, flexible knitted textiles that offer seamless mobility, wrinkle resistance, and tactile depth while preserving the poetic grace of ethnic drapes.

### Ready to Wear (Prêt-à-Porter)
- 24 signature looks available with custom fittings, color alterations, and bespoke sizing.
- Inquiries handled directly via WhatsApp with the styling team for custom measurement forms and delivery timelines.

## 4. Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q: Where is Studio Subhra located?
A: Studio Subhra is based in Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal, India. Private atelier viewings and styling consultations are available by appointment.

Q: How can I order or inquire about pricing?
A: Due to the bespoke, limited-edition nature of each garment, pricing is provided upon request. Clients can click the "Contact for Pricing" button on any product card or WhatsApp +91 98756 29283 directly with the look name.

Q: Does Studio Subhra ship internationally?
A: Yes, Studio Subhra provides worldwide expedited shipping with secure packaging and tracking for international clients in the USA, UK, UAE, Canada, Australia, and across Europe.

Q: Are custom fittings and personalized colors available?
A: Yes, Subhra Saha's atelier specializes in custom-made haute couture, bridal trousseaus, and made-to-measure sizing tailored to each client's individual silhouette.
